hero.title: Save animal lives through blood donation.
hero.subtitle: REDLINK connects veterinary clinics with willing pet owners for emergency transfusions.

steps.title: How does it work?
steps.1_desc: Clinics and pet owners create their profiles in just a few clicks.
steps.2_desc: Clinics send a request in case of emergency. REDLINK automatically notifies compatible donors.
steps.3_desc: Owners respond, go to the clinic, and help save a life.

why.title: Why REDLINK?
why.subtitle: A vital link between veterinary medicine and solidarity.

points.fast: Fast: Instant matching thanks to geolocation
points.target: Targeted: Search filtered by species, blood type, and weight
points.transparent: Transparent: The owner remains in control at every stage
points.secure: Secure: Data protected and accessible only to veterinarians
points.useful: Useful: Every donation can save a life

testimonial.text: Thanks to REDLINK, we were able to carry out two critical transfusions this month. The system is smooth and donors are responsive.
testimonial.author: Dr Petton

join.title: Join the solidarity network
join.subtitle: Every second counts. Together, we can make a difference.

faq.title: A question? You'll likely find the answer here!
faq.label: FAQ
faq.q1: Does my pet need to fast?
faq.a1: It is recommended that they haven't eaten a few hours before, but water is allowed.
faq.a2: No, it's like a regular blood draw. A numbing cream can be applied.
faq.q3: What does my pet receive in return?
faq.a3: A free complete blood test, treats, and the pride of saving a life!

legal.title: Legal Notice & Privacy
legal.placeholder_notice: Legal notice to be completed with the partner veterinary school's information before going into production.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.body: This application is a prototype developed as part of a pilot project with a partner veterinary school. The legal notice (publisher, host, publication director, registration number) will be completed before any real production launch.

privacy.title: Privacy and data protection (GDPR)
privacy.intro: As part of its operation, Redlink collects and processes personal data.
privacy.data_contact: Contact details: email address, phone number, postal address
privacy.data_geoloc: Geolocation: GPS coordinates of the address provided, used to calculate the distance between a donor animal and a clinic
privacy.data_animals: Animal-related data: species, breed, blood group, donation history, availability
privacy.usage: This data is used exclusively to match veterinary clinics with donor animal owners.
privacy.rights: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data, exercisable directly from your personal space (account deletion) or by contacting us via the Support page. This page will be completed with the full regulatory information (legal basis for processing, retention period, data protection officer contact details where applicable) before going into production.

support.title: Support & Contact
support.intro: A question, a technical issue, or need help using Redlink? Find answers to frequently asked questions below, or contact us directly.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: During the pilot phase, support is provided directly by the partner veterinary school. A dedicated contact address will be communicated before going into production — in the meantime, reach out to your on-site contact.

footer.question_desc: Ask us anything — we respond within 24 hours.
